claims.statement: Content guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES; repository writers can add Jekyll content to an existing Jekyll site. Writer role does not prove merge permission, bypass authority, native configuration rights or approved publication.
Pages are undated standalone content, posts reside in _posts; default about.md and starter post are examples, not universal existing files in every repository.
Theme layouts/styles normally apply and can be overridden. YAML front matter supplies metadata; local preview recommendation does not prove a completed local test or live deployment.

New page procedure creates PAGE-NAME.md at publishing-source root and supplies page layout, title and permalink. Example https://octocat.github.io mapping assumes that base; project-site base paths/custom-domain settings require effective rendered-route verification.
Page/post front-matter snippets are marked shell yet contain YAML and omit enclosing triple-dash delimiters. Treat them as illustrative metadata, not shell commands or guaranteed complete files.
Posts use _posts/YYYY-MM-DD-NAME-OF-POST.md with layout post, quoted title, date/time/timezone and categories. Placeholder formatting is not validated concrete date, filename or timezone evidence.

Source predicts YYYY/MM/DD/TITLE.html after publication; filename slug, configured permalink, category and base-path behavior can vary. Statement does not establish exact served route or successful post publication.

Commit includes cover message, cloud verified email and branch/PR recommendation. Later unconditional PR/merge steps must be qualified by whether a PR exists, protections and actual merge authorization; direct-commit choice does not imply an available PR.
Merge and confirm instructions may trigger publication through source or custom workflow, subject to triggering and successful build/deploy. Source's should-now-be-up statement is not a receipt.
Delete-branch step is post-merge cleanup advice, not authority to delete any current branch or proof parity/recoverability. No branch deleted, PR merged or source workflow executed.

Linked Jekyll documentation, site creation and theme pages are navigation rather than certified linked review. All claims remain reference-only; no accepted policy, rights clearance, published assurance or native rollout.
